environment.transport: localhost HTTP/1.1; fresh connection per request; catalog POST has JSON body
environment.client: Python 3.14.3 stdlib threads; same host as server
environment.warmup: one validated request per client before each round; OS/database caches warm
environment.loadModel: fixed arrivals; latency includes scheduling/client queue; client admission capped at four times concurrency

scope: Synthetic local catalogs. Not production capacity, external network latency, LLM speed or a Shopware comparison.
